caption: The drawing depicts a group of five figures, each riding a horse, arranged in a single line on a rectangular base. The figures are rendered in shades of brown, gray, and beige, with darker lines emphasizing details. Four of the figures are wearing feathered headdresses and holding bows with arrows nocked, while the central figure, facing forward, appears to be wearing a helmet and holding a different object. The horses, similarly colored in earthy tones, are in a dynamic pose as if running. The figures are all positioned upright, with their legs straddling the horses. The image is set against a light beige background with no additional elements, and there is a faint inscription below the platform in the lower right corner.
title: Indians
